Early in their history, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] dispatched an '''exploratory vessel''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] that used a [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumble hyperdrive]], though the ship's remains were lost by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Tumbling Down}}</ref>
